answer:
I renamed the Amt column to "Amount (kr)" in Household expenses. `check_app` found no problems after the changes, but I didn't open the App side to look at it myself.

The app looked up the column by the exact name "Amt", so the rename would have broken the total. I changed it to also accept names starting with "Amount". The total and the amounts per row should now show as before.

I also made the app use Amber Notes' own colours and layout, because `check_app` flagged the old hard-coded styling. That changes how it looks slightly, including in dark mode.
